test.create_query: CREATE TABLE psk_build (k_short String, k_long String, k_mixed String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE psk_build_1m (k String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE psk_build_dup (k String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE psk_build_100k (k_256 String, k_20 String, v UInt64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE psk_probe (k_short String, k_long String, k_long_1m String, k_long_miss String, k_long_skew String, k_mixed String, k_long_dup String) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE psk_probe_256 (k String) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE psk_probe_20 (k String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO psk_build SELECT toString(number), UUIDNumToString(sipHash128(number)), concat(toString(number), ':', substring(hex(sipHash128(number)), 1, number % 33)), number FROM numbers_mt(8000000)
INSERT INTO psk_build_1m SELECT UUIDNumToString(sipHash128(number)), number FROM numbers_mt(1000000)
INSERT INTO psk_build_dup SELECT UUIDNumToString(sipHash128(toUInt64(number % 4000000))), number FROM numbers_mt(8000000)
INSERT INTO psk_build_100k SELECT substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(number)), 8), 1, 256), substring(hex(sipHash128(number)), 1, 20), number FROM numbers_mt(100000)

INSERT INTO psk_probe SELECT toString(id_8m), UUIDNumToString(sipHash128(id_8m)), UUIDNumToString(sipHash128(id_1m)), UUIDNumToString(sipHash128(toUInt64(8000000 + number))), UUIDNumToString(sipHash128(toUInt64(pow(intHash64(number) / 18446744073709551615., 3) * 8000000))), concat(toString(id_8m), ':', substring(hex(sipHash128(id_8m)), 1, id_8m % 33)), UUIDNumToString(sipHash128(id_4m)) FROM ( SELECT number, cityHash64(number) % 2 = 0 AS hit, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 8000000, 8000000 + number % 2000000)) AS id_8m, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 1000000, 1000000 + number)) AS id_1m, toUInt64(if(hit, intHash64(number + 1) % 4000000, 4000000 + number)) AS id_4m FROM numbers_mt(20000000) )

INSERT INTO psk_probe_256 SELECT substring(repeat(hex(sipHash128(id)), 8), 1, 256) FROM (SELECT toUInt64(if(cityHash64(number) % 2 = 0, intHash64(number + 1) % 100000, 100000 + number)) AS id FROM numbers_mt(2500000))

INSERT INTO psk_probe_20 SELECT substring(hex(sipHash128(id)), 1, 20) FROM (SELECT toUInt64(if(cityHash64(number) % 2 = 0, intHash64(number + 1) % 100000, 100000 + number)) AS id FROM numbers_mt(8000000))
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM psk_probe AS l INNER JOIN psk_build AS r ON l.k_short = r.k_short FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM psk_probe AS l INNER JOIN psk_build AS r ON l.k_long = r.k_long FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM psk_probe AS l INNER JOIN psk_build_1m AS r ON l.k_long_1m = r.k FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM psk_probe AS l INNER JOIN psk_build AS r ON l.k_long_miss = r.k_long FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM psk_probe AS l INNER JOIN psk_build AS r ON l.k_long_skew = r.k_long FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM psk_probe AS l INNER JOIN psk_build AS r ON l.k_mixed = r.k_mixed FORMAT Null
SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM psk_probe AS l INNER JOIN psk_build_dup AS r ON l.k_long_dup = r.k FORMAT Null

SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM (SELECT k FROM psk_probe_256 UNION ALL SELECT k FROM psk_probe_256 UNION ALL SELECT k FROM psk_probe_256 UNION ALL SELECT k FROM psk_probe_256 UNION ALL SELECT k FROM psk_probe_256 UNION ALL SELECT k FROM psk_probe_256) AS l INNER JOIN psk_build_100k AS r ON l.k = r.k_256 FORMAT Null

SELECT count(), sum(r.v) FROM (SELECT k FROM psk_probe_20 UNION ALL SELECT k FROM psk_probe_20 UNION ALL SELECT k FROM psk_probe_20 UNION ALL SELECT k FROM psk_probe_20) AS l INNER JOIN psk_build_100k AS r ON l.k = r.k_20 FORMAT Null
